# Optidigi

> Optidigi is a Dutch digital partner for small and medium-sized businesses. It designs, builds and integrates software, AI applications and automation around existing business processes.

Optidigi serves business customers in the Netherlands. The website is available in Dutch and English. Use the Dutch pages as the default source and the English pages for English-language answers.

## Main pages

- [Optidigi homepage](https://optidigi.nl/): Dutch overview of Optidigi's services, approach and frequently asked questions.
- [Optidigi homepage in English](https://optidigi.nl/en/): English overview of the same services and approach.
- [Contact Optidigi](https://optidigi.nl/contact): Send a business enquiry or arrange a no-obligation call.
- [Contact Optidigi in English](https://optidigi.nl/en/contact): English contact and appointment page.

## Legal and privacy

- [Legal documents](https://optidigi.nl/juridisch): Current legal documents and publication status in Dutch.
- [Legal documents in English](https://optidigi.nl/en/legal): English index of the legal documents.
- [General terms and conditions](https://optidigi.nl/juridisch/algemene-voorwaarden): Official Dutch business-to-business terms, version 1.0.
- [Privacy policy](https://optidigi.nl/privacy): How Optidigi processes personal data.
- [Privacy policy in English](https://optidigi.nl/en/privacy): English version of the privacy policy.

## Notes

- Optidigi works with software, websites and portals, cloud software, AI applications, integrations and workflow automation.
- Product names and interface data shown in visual demonstrations are illustrative examples, not separate Optidigi products or customer claims.
- Documents marked as coming soon on the legal index have not yet been published.
